steps.content: Violent tremors come from the pit, and the pool of contamination rises.
Somewhere close to the surface of the pool, the three Sinner girls are looking at each other.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: The person you're looking for isn't here. He left early in the morning.
steps.female_content: The person you're looking for isn't here. She left early in the morning.

steps.content: Before Hella gets a chance to start cursing, she sees Hecate frozen on the spot, and rushes forward to comfort her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. He'll have an explanation for this for sure!
steps.female_content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. She'll have an explanation for this for sure!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Plus, who the f*** are you? Where did a little kid like you come from? You have a death wish coming to this kind of place?
Crache's face darkens, and the shadows under her feet pounce on Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm asking you a question, why... Hey hey hey...
The shadow lifts up Hella upside-down by the ankles, and the two lock eyes with each other. Hella thrashes about like a fish out of water struggling for oxygen.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate! Don't just stare! Get me down!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She means no harm.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How would you know? Don't come crying for help if she picks you up like this later, too!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I promised that "dear Chief" of yours to <color=#fb9259>look after you</color>. I can pick you up and throw you down there any time I want.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You met Chief?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What did he tell you?
Hecate's tone is gloomy and somber. Crache glances at her, and tosses Hella next to her like a rag doll.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Sigh... He said he had to go do something stupid, and didn't want you to get involved. He knew you wouldn't listen to him, so he had to leave secretly.
steps.female_content: Sigh... She said she had to go do something stupid, and didn't want you to get involved. She knew you wouldn't listen to her, so she had to leave secretly.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is he in danger right now?
steps.female_content: Is she in danger right now?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Who knows. Probably doing better than you two.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Then where is Chief...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Tsk... I don't like passing messages for people, and I certainly don't like doing things for grown-ups. I'm already making an exception right now.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: That guy's really worried about you two, and hopes you can have a safe return. If you care about him so much, you should take good care of yourselves first.
steps.female_content: That lady's really worried about you two, and hopes you can have a safe return. If you care about her so much, you should take good care of yourselves first.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Syndicate is already in chaos. Don't run around here, and don't get whisked away so easily. This place is rotten to the core. Go back to the Bureau and never come back.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I get it now. Chief is still in Syndicate. Where is he?
steps.female_content: I get it now. Chief is still in Syndicate. Where is she?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...You little tyke...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: My mission is to protect Chief. If Chief comes to Syndicate, I will follow him here. If Chief thinks there's still hope for this place, I will be by his side.
steps.female_content: My mission is to protect Chief. If Chief comes to Syndicate, I will follow her here. If Chief thinks there's still hope for this place, I will be by her side.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't need you to tell me what to do.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Exactly! Even though I always complain about this place, I don't like it when you say things like that.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So many people are trying their best to do good things, like the Legion, Rustfire, and also ${PlayerName}. They're all trying to change Syndicate for the better. Who are you to say that it's rotten to the core?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're so young but you sound like a grandma. Don't you know that change is coming to Syndicate?
She starts using other people's catchphrases to boast.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...All of you are so naive. This is all your <color=#fb9259>Chief</color>'s fault, isn't it. He seems like a daydreamer.
steps.female_content: ...All of you are so naive. This is all your Chief's fault, isn't it. She seems like a daydreamer.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: It's too late for change now.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: No matter what you think, or whether you like it or not, most people here have become habituated to violence. It's their first go-to whenever there's trouble.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: They'll use violence to try to bring change. They'll use violence to achieve their dreams. The easiest and most effective solution in Syndicate is always violence. If there's a coup now, it'll only...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Forget it. If you really care about him, think of a way to get him out.
steps.female_content: Forget it. If you really care about her, think of a way to get her out.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Before that raven catches up, I'll let you guys out. Hurry, first...
Boom—
The contamination bursts like a spring, unleashing violent tremors.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: What's going on down there? I thought that monster's already dead. Could it be that the other half is...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's shackles!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I feel the shackles down there! Chief is fighting!
